content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Combining and Splitting Text focuses on the following parts of the supplied syllabus: CONCAT; TEXTJOIN; LEFT , RIGHT , and MID; Combining names, identifiers, and labels. Keep the underlying source data visible and make each assumption explicit.

content_blocks.run_instructions: Use a scratch copy and check the output for blank cells, extra spaces, case differences and unexpected delimiters. Some modern text functions require newer Excel versions.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Work in a duplicate workbook or a scratch sheet. Restore the input range and formula/code to the original state, clear filters or selections, then rerun the same test cases. Record expected and actual behavior rather than assuming a successful result.

content_blocks.text: Create a small worksheet or workbook section that demonstrates combining and splitting text. Where the concept requires a specialized Excel feature, first verify that feature is available in your Excel edition.
